sloka: ततो वरार्हः सुविशुद्धभावा ।स्तेषाम् स्त्रियस्तत्र महानुभावाह् ।प्रियेषु पानेषु च सक्तभावा ।ददर्श ताराइव सुप्रभावाः ॥५-५-१७॥
transliteration: tato varārhaḥ suviśuddhabhāvā ।steṣām striyastatra mahānubhāvāh ।priyeṣu pāneṣu ca saktabhāvā ।dadarśa tārāiva suprabhāvāḥ ॥5-5-17॥

translations.english: There he saw demonesses adorned with choicest ornaments, their minds attached faithfully to their husbands and bottles of wine. Some of the wives of the demons, however, looked gentle and bright like stars.
